title: Longest Palindromic Chunk Decomposition
statement: Given a string S, find the maximum number of chunks K such that S = A[1] + A[2] + ... + A[K] where A[i] == A[K - i + 1] for all valid 1 <= i <= K.
input_format: A single line containing the string S.
output_format: Output the maximum number of chunks K.
